ACTION6.effect: The only action in the game. A click resolves to a grid cell (:21377), the sprites there are fetched (:21380), and the step does something ONLY if one of them carries a tag whose first element contains 'button' (:21383). The tag is then split on '_' (:21385) and must have exactly three parts (:21386); part 1 names the row or column the button drives and part 2 is 'R' or anything else, which becomes the direction boolean at :21389. The resulting moves are collected at :21396-:21403 and applied at :21405.

there must be sprites at that cell.

branch_conditions.meaning: THE gate - the sprite's first tag must contain 'button'. Anything else and the click does nothing.
the button tag must split into exactly three underscore-separated parts, or it is ignored.

branch_conditions.meaning: direction is 'R' or not-'R'; there is no third case.

unhandled_actions.note: ACTION1-5, ACTION7 and RESET have no branch in Lp85.step and none but RESET is offered. RESET is handled by arcengine, which is not vendored.

sibling_builds.reason: lp85-305b61c3 is the only lp85 build in either replay manifest and the only lp85 directory under docs/static/games/src/. The question does not arise. See dispatch/README.md.

notes: A one-verb game: every decision is which button to press. The falsifiable content is which row or column a given button drives and in which direction, which is exactly what the tag at :21385 encodes and what an agent cannot read off the board.

A click that misses a button returns at :21410 before the level-complete and loss tests, so it costs nothing. A record must not treat a no-change row here as a failed prediction without checking the click landed on a button.
No recording on disk. Source-only, no cross-check against play.
